work.heading: Work
work.intro: The strongest evidence is the kind you can inspect. This site is open source, from its design tokens to its test suite.

thisSite.title: This site
thisSite.summary: One design system, three visual identities. Contrast is tested in every theme, and every change has to pass accessibility and performance budgets before it ships.

work.more: More case studies are published as they're cleared for release.

changelog.heading: Changelog
changelog.intro: My career as release notes. Each major version marks a new level of responsibility. From v1 on, each one is named after a Costa Rican volcano, higher than the last.

notes.heading: Notes
notes.empty: Essays on frontend architecture, performance and accessibility. The first one, on parallel code that actually scales, is in progress.
